messages:
lia: Quick announcement: weve added an HSM/KMS attestation workflow for Private installs. This helps customers prove key custody during audits. Docs and example artifacts are in the release folder, please review and ACK.

omar: Link? Any infra changes required?

lia: Release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/private-kms-hsm-attest-v1. It outlines two new pieces: (1) `kms-attest` agent that produces signed attestation PDFs and (2) an operator endpoint to collect attestation bundles. No DB schema changes.

polly-devex: We'll need a short customer-facing FAQ and sample attestation excerpt. I'll draft both.

chris-compliance: Legal note: attestation must include key rotation history and proof of key origin. Also require a documented chain-of-custody section. I'll add a template to the doc.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: private-kms-attest-agent-1785001235

omar: Agent deployed to staging. Smoke test command:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <OPERATOR>" \
  -X POST https://staging-priv.redwood.local/v1/admin/generate_kms_attestation?customer=beta-co
```
Output writes to `s3://priv-attest/beta-co/attestation-<ts>.pdf`.

polly-devex: Draft FAQ uploaded: https://drive.google.com/priv-kms-faq (v0.1). It explains what is included and how to request full trace exports (requires signed consent).

chris-compliance: Uploaded attestation template `attest-template-178500`. Key asks: include KMS key ARN, creation date, rotation policy, and HSM vendor certificate fingerprint.

lia: Action items:
- omar: validate attestation contents and automate manifest creation (due Fri)
- polly-devex: customer FAQ + sample excerpt (due Thu)
- chris-compliance: final legal template (due Thu EOD)

Please ACK on this thread when you have the items. :metal:

omar: ACK - will run validation tests and update infra checks.

polly-devex: ACK - drafting sample attestation excerpt now.

chris-compliance: ACK - will finalize template and sign-off.

lia: Thanks team. We'll include this in next week's customer newsletter once legal signs off. If anything blocks, reply here. :calendar:
